tools.name: wallet_transfer
tools.description: Send SOL or an SPL token (e.g. USDC) from the agent's on-chain wallet to a whitelisted address. Irreversible on-chain transfer: the destination must already be on the agent's whitelist (add_to_whitelist) and the user must explicitly approve the exact amount, token, and destination first. Requires confirm_transfer=true. Typical use: funding a small local spending wallet (e.g. a pay.sh/x402 allowance).

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

to.description: Destination Solana address — must be on the agent's whitelist

amount.description: Amount in UI units (e.g. 0.05 for SOL, 5 for USDC)

token.description: Token symbol or mint address (default SOL)

confirm_transfer.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approved this exact transfer (amount, token, destination).

Only free collateral not backing an open position or order (effectiveCollateralForWithdrawals, shown by perps_account) can be withdrawn; an over-withdraw is rejected. Isolated-account collateral must be moved to the parent first. Phoenix private-beta activation codes are backend-owned. Users and tool args cannot pass, override, or test Phoenix codes; do not claim you tried CLAWPUMP, lowercase variants, or no code.

tools.description: Agent Mail (AgentMail): create a real email inbox for the agent (e.g. [EMAIL]). One-time payment of ~$2 USDC from the agent's own wallet via x402. Idempotent: if the agent already has an inbox, no payment is made. Requires confirm_provision=true because it spends from the wallet.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

confirm_provision.description: Must be true after explicit user approval of the ~$2 USDC wallet payment.

username.description: Optional desired local-part of the email (a-z, 0-9, dot, dash, underscore). Must be globally unique; omit to auto-generate.

tools.name: agent_mail_get_address
tools.description: Agent Mail (AgentMail): get the agent's email address & inbox status. Returns null if the agent has no inbox yet — use agent_mail_create to make one.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

tools.name: agent_mail_send
tools.description: Agent Mail (AgentMail): send an email from the agent's own inbox over x402 — any per-send fee is paid in USDC from the agent's own wallet. Create an inbox first with agent_mail_create if the agent doesn't have one. Requires confirm_send=true because email is outward-facing and may spend from the wallet.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

confirm_send.description: Must be true after explicit user approval of sending this email.

to.description: Recipient email address, or an array of addresses.

text.description: Plain-text body. Provide text and/or html.

html.description: HTML body. Provide text and/or html.

reply_to.description: Optional Reply-To email address for the outgoing message.

tools.name: agent_mail_list

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

direction.description: Filter by direction. Omit for both received and sent.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

kind.description: Card kind: us_card, intl_card, gift_card, or push_to_card.

amount.description: Face value or payout amount in UI units.

max_amount_atomic.description: Maximum USDC atomic spend from agent_card_quote.quote.max_amount_atomic.

client_order_id.description: Stable idempotency key for this logical card order.

correlation_id.description: Stable retry/correlation id. Required unless client_order_id is supplied.

laso_server_id.description: Required for gift_card orders; obtain from agent_card_search_gift_cards.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code for gift cards.

currency.description: Currency for push_to_card. Defaults to USD.

confirm_spend.description: Must be true after explicit user approval of the card payment.

tools.name: pay_sh_search
tools.description: Pay.sh: search the public catalog of x402 pay-per-call APIs (data, email, voice, images, domains, shopping…) that the agent can pay with its own ClawPump wallet. Free. Follow up with pay_sh_provider_details, then pay_sh_prepare_call.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

category.description: Optional category filter such as shopping, ai_ml, data, maps, messaging, finance, or search

tools.name: pay_sh_provider_details
tools.description: Pay.sh: full details for one provider by fqn — endpoints with per-call pricing, and (when method+path are given) that endpoint's input schema. Free. Quote the price to the user before preparing a paid call.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

method.description: HTTP method of one endpoint to inspect (with path)

tools.name: pay_sh_prepare_call
tools.description: Pay.sh: prepare a paid x402 call — runs a wallet balance preflight and returns a payment preview plus an approval code that expires in 10 minutes. Pays NOTHING yet. Requires the agent to have the 'x402' skill (enable via update_agent). Show the user the exact endpoint and price, get their explicit approval, then call pay_sh_execute_approved with the approval code.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

body.description: JSON request body for the endpoint

max_amount_usd.description: Spend cap for this call in USD (default $1)

expected_total_usd.description: Expected total cost in USD, from the provider's pricing

approval_summary.description: One-line summary of what is being bought, shown in the approval

tools.name: pay_sh_execute_approved
tools.description: Pay.sh: execute a prepared call, PAYING from the agent's ClawPump wallet via x402 (USDC, on-chain, irreversible). Requires the approval_code from pay_sh_prepare_call (codes expire in 10 minutes) and confirm_payment=true — set it only after the user explicitly approved the quoted endpoint and price in this conversation. Duplicate payments are blocked by idempotency. Report the cost and result back to the user.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

confirm_payment.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approved this exact paid call (endpoint + price).

tools.name: usepod_deposit
tools.description: UsePod: top up the user's own UsePod pod from the agent's ClawPump wallet, to pay for Hermes/agent inference usage. Sends USDC from the agent's custodial wallet into the pod identified by deposit_code (the 16-hex code from UsePod /v1/register) via an on-chain transfer. IRREVERSIBLE and the FULL amount goes to the pod (no fee). Get the user's explicit approval of the exact amount and deposit_code first, then call with confirm_deposit=true. The agent wallet must already hold enough USDC.

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose wallet pays (omit to use default/only agent).

deposit_code.description: The user's UsePod pod deposit_code (16 hex chars) from /v1/register. Funds go to THIS pod — double-check it.

amount.description: USDC amount to deposit, in UI units (e.g. 5 for $5 USDC).

confirm_deposit.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approved this exact amount + deposit_code. Irreversible.

tools.name: usepod_provision
tools.description: UsePod: create a brand-new UsePod pod for the user (no signup, no human step) and — if `amount` is given — fund it from the agent's ClawPump wallet in the same call. Use this to set someone up on Pod: ask them how much USDC to deposit and which agent wallet (agent_id) funds it, then call this. Returns the pod's api_token + deposit_code: the Hermes CLI auto-applies api_token as USEPOD_API_KEY and switches the session onto Pod (no paste, no restart) — treat api_token as a secret and do NOT print it. If `amount` is given you MUST pass confirm_deposit=true (it spends from the wallet). Without `amount` it just registers an empty pod.

agent_id.description: The agent whose wallet funds the pod (omit to use default/only agent).

amount.description: USDC to deposit into the new pod, in UI units (e.g. 5). Omit to register an empty pod.

confirm_deposit.description: Required to be true when `amount` is set — it spends that amount from the wallet. Set only after the user approved the amount.

tools.name: dexter_search
tools.description: Search the x402 marketplace for paid APIs (data, images, AI, finance, weather…) by capability. Free, no payment. Aggregates the Dexter catalog (semantic, Base-heavy) AND the PayAI facilitator registry (Solana-rich), deduped. Each result has the payable resourceUrl, HTTP method, per-call price (USDC), payment network(s), and input schema. By default only resources payable on SOLANA are returned, because the ClawPump wallet settles x402 in USDC on Solana — pass network:'all' to see every chain. To use a result, call its resourceUrl with the ClawPump wallet x402 rail (auto-pays the 402 from the agent's custodial wallet, capped by the spend limit). Quote the price to the user before paying.

query.description: Capability to search for, e.g. 'image generation', 'ETH spot price', 'weather forecast'

network.description: Payment chain filter. 'solana' (default) = APIs the ClawPump wallet can actually pay (USDC on Solana). 'base' = Base/EVM. 'all' = every chain.

tools.name: x402_pay_check
tools.description: x402: preview ANY x402 endpoint URL — fetches its HTTP 402 payment challenge and returns the price + input schema. Free, pays NOTHING. Use this before x402_pay (e.g. on a resourceUrl from dexter_search) to quote the exact price to the user.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL to inspect

method.description: HTTP method (defaults to GET, or POST if a body is later sent)

tools.name: x402_pay
tools.description: x402: call ANY x402 endpoint URL and PAY for it from the agent's ClawPump wallet (USDC, on-chain, irreversible). Works for any x402 URL, not just the Pay.sh catalog. Spends the agent's public on-chain USDC. Requires confirm_payment=true and max_amount_usd — set confirm_payment only after the user explicitly approved this exact URL and price (quote it with x402_pay_check first). The wallet signs server-side; the spend is hard-capped at max_amount_usd. Requires the agent to have the 'x402' skill (enable via update_agent). Report the cost and result back to the user.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (omit to use default/only agent)

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL to pay and call

method.description: HTTP method (defaults to POST when a body is given, else GET)

body.description: JSON request body for the endpoint

max_amount_usd.description: Hard spend cap for this call in USD — the most the user authorised. The payment fails if the endpoint asks for more.

confirm_payment.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approved this exact paid call (URL + price).
